{{Quote|I hope you're hungry, Bomo!, I decided to cook up all of the Gorka thighs before they went bad!.|Ratty cooking|<ref name="Dark Times 16">[[Dark Times 16|''Dark Times'' 16]]</ref>}}
'''Gorka thighs''' were the thighs of an unknown animal. They were edible to many species.

While hiding at their vacation haunt on [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]], [[Meekerdin-maa]] cooked Gorka thighs for the dwindling crew of the [[Uhumele]] one afternoon. He first offered some to [[Bomo Greenbark]] but the latter wasn't in the mood to eat.
